children: Western Alliance Bancorporation declared quarterly cash dividends on its common and preferred stock.
The company declared a $0.46 per-share common stock dividend, payable November 27, 2026, to shareholders of record November 12.
The board declared a $209 per-share dividend on its 4.250% Series A preferred stock, equivalent to $0.5225 per depositary share.
The preferred stock dividend is payable December 30, 2026, to shareholders of record December 15.
